reviews.conclusion: Three visible pause/settings visits span combined transition bounds 4.0-5.5 s, compatible with the 4.417 s deficit.

Two pause/options visits are visible around an extremely zoomed eye-of-ender view. Clearly visible menu samples total approximately 2.75-3.75 s; a darkened but tightly cropped eye view at 5.75-6.0 s may already be paused. Thus the -3.75 s deficit is compatible with observed menu activity, while exact closure remains limited by the cropped game window.
Options/video-settings visit spans transition bounds 1.5-2.0 s, compatible with the 1.917 s deficit.

The clip shows death and respawn in the stronghold, then an End transition and pause/options/video-settings sequence approximately 1.5-2.0 s long, compatible with -1.9 s. Inventory and death-screen time are not automatically counted as paused GUI time.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
